title: Gotrade Daily: Micron Reports Tonight as PCE Data Lands
summary: Micron reports after the US close, and PCE data lands at 8:30 a.m. ET. Your US watchlist for tonight: MU, NVDA, BA, and NKE.
body_markdown:
### PCE and GDP data at 8:30 a.m. ET


August personal income and outlays data, including the PCE price index, lands alongside the third estimate of second-quarter GDP at[8:30 a.m. ET](https://www.bea.gov/news/schedule) . PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge. According to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/articles/big-week-jobs-inflation-data-133100490.html) , headline PCE is expected to 3.7% year over year and core PCE to 3.2%. A hotter-than-expected print could push yields higher again and weigh on tech stocks.


### Boeing wins the Navy fighter contract


**Boeing (**[BA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/ba/) **)** won the US Navy's F/A-XX fighter program, with a $20 billion contract to develop test aircraft, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/boeing-wins-us-navys-nextgeneration-fighter-contract-sources-say-4923747) . According to[Boeing](https://boeing.mediaroom.com/2026-09-29-U-S-Navy-Selects-Boeing-for-F-A-XX-Program) , it is the company's second sixth-generation fighter program, after the Air Force's F-47. BA shares rose more than 2% in extended trading on Tuesday.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


On Tuesday evening US time, S&P 500 futures were up 0.17% and Nasdaq 100 futures were up 0.25%, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-drift-higher-as-yields-pause-oil-prices-slide-4923936) . Beyond the watchlist, **Carnival (**[CCL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/ccl/) **)** jumped 13.41% to $25.11 on Tuesday. According to[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/09/29/stock-market-today-sept-29-carnival-surges-13-on-record-bookings-raised-guidance/) , adjusted EPS of $1.43 and revenue of $8.44 billion both beat estimates.


## Macro Note 📝


The US dollar is heading for its best month since June on Fed rate-hike bets, according to[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-30/dollar-powers-to-best-month-since-june-on-fed-s-inflation-fight) . Oil fell more than 2% on Tuesday as supplies from Saudi Arabia improved, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-drift-higher-as-yields-pause-oil-prices-slide-4923936) .


## Conclusion


Tonight, the market tests two things: the inflation path through PCE, then the strength of AI chip demand through Micron's report. With MU shares already up sharply, management's guidance may matter as much as this quarter's numbers.


After that, watch **Nike (**[NKE](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nke/) **)** , which reports Thursday after the US close. According to[StockStory](https://markets.financialcontent.com/stocks/article/stockstory-2026-9-30-nike-nke-reports-q3-everything-you-need-to-know-ahead-of-earnings) , NKE shares are down 8.1% over the past month.
